# RunnableFunction::GetName behavior in xpcom/rust/moz_task/src/dispatcher.rs

Copies the stored static task name into the caller-provided XPCOM string.

## State read

- self.name

## State changed

- *result assigned name

## Calls and triggers

- nsACString::assign(self.name)

## Result and consumers

NS_OK and assigned out parameter consumed by native named-runnable users.

## Errors

Unsafe caller must provide a valid writable result pointer; no null check.

## Async completion

Synchronous.

## Ownership and cleanup

Name is static; output owns its assigned string.
